title: research_harness round input
description: Per-round evaluation knobs, delivered to the referee as CONFIG_JSON. Every one of these may only make the round EASIER or SMALLER than the spec/referee defaults; the token pool is additionally clamped to the platform's MODEL_TOKEN_BUDGET. The corpus and questions themselves are not configurable: they derive entirely from the platform's per-round SEED, which never reaches a player sandbox.

num_questions.description: Questions in the round. The seven templates are cycled, so a multiple of 7 keeps the difficulty mix balanced. Round-to-round sd is ~0.029 at 64 (HANDOFF.md §4).

token_pool.description: Prompt+completion tokens the whole episode may spend, shared across every question. This is the competition's central scarcity: allocating it across questions is the skill being measured. Clamped to MODEL_TOKEN_BUDGET.

max_steps_per_question.description: Action cap per question, so a harness cannot stall the round.

max_context_tokens.description: Ceiling on the referee-side context buffer, so 'add every document' is not a strategy.

trap_rate.description: Probability that a question gets an adversarial document planted on one hop of its chain (contradictor | stale | injection | ambiguous, chosen uniformly).

deadline_ms.description: Per-action wall clock the player must respond within. Model latency is the referee's problem, not the harness's, so this only needs to cover the harness's own decision.
